title: 2026 International King Kong Grip Challenge - Canberra
description: Test your grip strength against the best worldwide at Canberra's venue for the King Kong Grip Challenge. See how you rank globally! The King Kong International Grip Challenge is a multi-venue global grip sport contest where the same 4 events are performed worldwide and scores are combined, giving athletes a global ranking. Ultra Fitness and Strength is happy to host a contest for grip athletes in Canberra and surrounding areas. This event is open to all levels of experience. Events will run on a rising bar format, allowing athletes to choose their opening weights and attempts.
